branch.new_demand: Solve an inverse problem with two observations: two trigonometric equations in two unknowns.

questions.prompt: From point A on level ground the angle of elevation to the top of a tower is 25°. From point B, 40 m closer, it is 40°. Find the tower's height to the nearest tenth of a meter.
questions.prompt_markup: From point A on level ground the angle of elevation to the top of a tower is 25°. From point B, 40 m closer, it is 40°. Find the tower's height to the nearest tenth of a meter.
questions.grading_note: Rounding to 0.1 required. h = 40 ÷ (1/tan 25° - 1/tan 40°) = 41.984. Two equations: h = x tan 40° and h = (x + 40) tan 25°.
